projects.name: Algo Matrics Platform
projects.summary: Multi-tenant algorithmic trading platform: strategies, brokers, risk controls, billing, real-time P&L and a full operations stack in one console.
highlights: SaaS core: plans and billing through Razorpay / Stripe with GST, broker connections (Zerodha, Angel One, Flattrade, paper trading), risk limits and kill switches.
Strategy SDK with sandboxed uploads, semantic versioning, an approval workflow, and backtesting with bar replay, Monte Carlo and walk-forward.
Clean Architecture / DDD monorepo with 152 commits, deployable with one Docker Compose command or on Kubernetes.

architecture.detail: FastAPI control plane (/api/v1) with JWT and rotating refresh tokens, RBAC, TOTP MFA, RFC 9457 errors and OWASP security headers.
Independent trading engine, market-data, worker and scheduler processes coordinated over Redis Streams (consumer groups, dead-letter queue, inbox dedupe).
PostgreSQL with async SQLAlchemy and Alembic migrations, Redis, a read-only DuckDB market-intelligence store, and a SHA-256 hash-chained audit log.
React + TypeScript operations console (Vite, Tailwind 4, TanStack Query) with live P&L, orders and positions over WebSocket.
Claude provider abstraction powering an in-app assistant and strategy explanations, plus an AI-CIO market-regime and ranking overlay.

Multi-cloud: runs across AWS and Google Cloud VMs, with Kubernetes manifests (KEDA / HPA autoscaling), pluggable secrets (env, AWS Secrets Manager, Fernet) and a VPS agent with mTLS for venue-side brokers.
Prometheus, Grafana, Loki and Alertmanager; circuit breakers, deep readiness probes and GitHub Actions CI.

projects.code_note: Private repository. Code walkthrough available on request.
overview: Algo Matrics is a multi-tenant platform for systematic trading on Indian equity and derivatives markets. A trader connects a broker, builds or uploads a strategy, versions and approves it, backtests it, then deploys it and watches live P&L, orders and positions stream in.
Risk limits and kill switches are enforced on the server, not in the browser. The public site is live at algomatrics.in, and console access is by invitation.

gallery.caption: Console, F&O heatmap: all 218 NSE F&O stocks grouped by sector, sized by market cap and coloured by % change.
Console, Market Intelligence: AI-CIO ranks which F&O stocks are likely to make a major move, and every forecast is graded against the close.
algomatrics.in: the live public site and what the platform covers.
Console sign-in: invite-only access with short-lived session tokens, and paper trading kept separate from live.
Engineering principles on the live site: fail closed, audited, least privilege.

decisions: Modular monolith (Clean Architecture / DDD) plus independent runtimes that talk over a Redis Streams event bus with consumer groups, a dead-letter queue and inbox deduplication.
Fail closed: readiness probes return 503 when a dependency degrades, circuit breakers isolate brokers, and kill switches stop trading at the server.
Tamper-evident audit: operator actions go into an append-only, SHA-256 hash-chained log.
Least privilege: secrets come from pluggable backends (env, AWS Secrets Manager, Fernet), and a VPS agent with a rotatable mTLS identity runs venue-side brokers without accepting arbitrary commands.
results: Runs across AWS and Google Cloud VMs, with one-command Docker Compose bring-up and Kubernetes manifests with KEDA / HPA autoscaling.
152 commits and 95 Python test files, with GitHub Actions CI for backend, integration, frontend, ops and container images.

projects.name: Autonomous Job Application Pipeline
projects.summary: Unattended pipeline that discovers jobs, tailors my resume with an LLM, applies through a browser bot and runs cold email outreach.
highlights: Gemini / OpenAI resume tailoring under a zero-hallucination prompt, compiled to PDF for every role.
Playwright apply bot with human-like typing, consent handling, CAPTCHA detection and a screenshot audit trail.
Cold email engine with threaded follow-ups, IMAP reply detection and daily send limits.

architecture.detail: Async Playwright scraper over Greenhouse and Lever boards configured in targets.json, filtered by role keywords, seniority and location before any posting is opened.
Google Sheets (gspread) as the tracker with URL deduplication and a local JSON fallback.
Provider-agnostic Gemini / OpenAI layer for resume tailoring and email drafting, with template fallbacks when no key is set.
Playwright bot types like a person, uploads the tailored PDF, handles consent boxes, detects CAPTCHAs and saves a screenshot of every attempt.
SMTP sending with the CV attached, IMAP reply checks, daily caps and randomized pacing.
FastAPI backend with a Server-Sent Events live console, run controls, application tracker and audit gallery.
Static CV site generated from cv.json and deployed to GitHub Pages by GitHub Actions.

overview: An unattended job-search system I built for my own search. It scans company job boards for the roles I target, checks a tracker to avoid duplicates, tailors my resume to each job with an LLM under a strict no-invention prompt, submits applications with a browser bot, and runs cold email outreach with follow-ups.
This portfolio site is generated by the same system from one structured CV file.

gallery.caption: Control center: live pipeline status, run controls and the architecture flow.
Portfolio builder: edit cv.json and preview this site live.
Cold outreach: contacts, drafts, daily limits and dry-run mode.

decisions: Zero-hallucination prompts: the LLM may only use facts from my CV, and without an API key the system falls back to the untouched master resume instead of inventing content.
Safe by default: applications and emails start in dry-run mode, with daily caps, randomized pacing and inbox reply detection before anything goes out.
Role and location filters run on the job listing page before any posting is opened, so per-board limits only count relevant roles.
One structured CV (cv.json) drives the website, the resume PDF, the master resume and the cold emails.
results: Offline test suite for the outreach rules (no double sends, threaded follow-ups, daily cap) that never touches the network.

projects.name: StudyPilot
projects.summary: Learning website for Class 7 students: short lessons, practice with hints, unit tests and timed practice papers. Live as a prototype.
highlights: Follows 9 school textbooks across 7 subjects: 256 topics, 219 lessons and 1,232 practice questions, all marked as drafts until a teacher reviews them.
Timed practice papers that save every answer, resume after a refresh and submit exactly once at the deadline.
Offline-first PWA: finished work goes into a durable IndexedDB outbox with idempotency keys.

architecture.detail: React + TypeScript single-page app built with Vite and Tailwind, with KaTeX maths in Markdown lessons.
Pure, tested modules for answer checking, grading, mastery and exam attempts.
PWA with an IndexedDB outbox and idempotency keys, so work is never lost or submitted twice.
Supabase (PostgreSQL) with version-controlled migrations, row-level security and server-side grading.
Cloudflare Pages for the student site and a separate admin site.

projects.code_note: Private repository. Code walkthrough available on request.
overview: StudyPilot is a student-first learning website for Class 7 that follows the textbooks the school uses. Students read short lessons, practise questions with hints, take chapter unit tests and timed practice papers, and see what to revise next.
It is live as a prototype: sign-up and email verification work, and every lesson is clearly labelled as a draft until a teacher reviews it.

gallery.caption: Live site: 9 textbooks, 256 topics and 1,232 practice questions, clearly marked as a prototype.

decisions: Honest by design: every lesson shows its review status, simulated features are labelled, and the rule-based Study Buddy says it is not an AI model.
Grading runs on the server, and the database is protected with row-level security policies.
Mastery counts only answers right the first time without hints, so progress reflects real understanding.
results: Live at studypilot-biw.pages.dev with working sign-up and email verification.
Test suite for logic, components, content integrity and database security, run before every commit.

projects.name: NIFTY / SENSEX Intraday Research Lab
projects.summary: Research workspace for intraday NIFTY / SENSEX trading: candle engines, feature and event discovery, walk-forward model tests and a paper-trading runtime.
highlights: Confidence-driven entry / exit research with walk-forward out-of-sample reporting, random baselines and cost sweeps.
Feature, event and edge discovery engines with FDR and Holm multiple-testing control.
Paper-trading runtime on a Linux server with a safety preflight before broker login.
projects.code_note: Private repository. Code walkthrough available on request.
overview: A research workspace for intraday NIFTY and SENSEX trading. It rebuilds 30-second and 1-minute candles from raw ticks, engineers indicator features, and tests ideas with walk-forward, out-of-sample validation and explicit trading costs.
Negative results are reported plainly: most ideas fail once costs and multiple testing are accounted for, and the dashboards below show that.

architecture.detail: Tick-to-candle reconstruction for 30s / 1m / 2m bars with schema, timestamp and sequence-gap guards.
Signed indicator votes, DI–TEMA crossover descriptors and 1,705 engineered features.
Feature, event and edge discovery engines with FDR / Holm correction and session bootstraps.
Walk-forward and leave-one-day-out tests with random baselines and cost sweeps.
Paper-trading runtime on a Linux server with engine-health and latency monitoring.

gallery.caption: Phase 3 alpha discovery: 1,705 features over 285 symbol-days, with walk-forward results net of a 5 bps option cost.
Event discovery: 30 candidate events tested out of sample with Holm correction and bootstrap intervals.
Entry models compared with leave-one-day-out walk-forward tests and a 1-point round-trip cost.
Spearman redundancy map showing which top features describe the same motion.
Out-of-sample edge-score calibration on 11 unseen sessions.

decisions: No-lookahead law: a decision at a bar uses only data up to that bar's close, enforced by asserts in the backtester.
Multiple-testing discipline: FDR and Holm corrections, session bootstraps and threshold perturbation before any result counts.
Costs first: every result is reported net of an explicit round-trip hurdle.
results: Phase 3: 1,104 of 1,705 features passed FDR and stability filters, but the best out-of-sample result was −3.98 bps after costs, so no strategy was promoted.
Event discovery: 0 of 30 candidate events survived Holm-corrected validation on 11 out-of-sample sessions.

projects.name: LLS: Low-Latency Trading Infrastructure
projects.summary: C++20 platform for market-data ingestion, incremental feature computation, ML inference and risk / execution infrastructure.
highlights: Lock-free SPSC ring-buffer pipeline from feed to a preallocated market-state engine with zero-copy snapshots.
C++ ML stack: purged walk-forward splits, leakage detection, tree ensembles, TCN / CNN1D models, calibration and a zero-allocation inference engine.
Differential oracle proving the C++ port reproduces a legacy Python strategy exactly; 214 C++ source files and 98 test files.

architecture.detail: Status / error types, strong IDs, structured logging, typed config, SPSC ring buffer, JSONL sinks, SHA-256.
Vendor-neutral instrument master, option-chain indexes and a multi-instrument market-state engine with freshness checks.
Gated TrueData WebSocket transport, fixture replay, normalization and raw capture recording (market data only).
Dataset construction, labelling, model registry, drift / shadow / replay validation and the inference runtime.
Intent validation, risk gate, sizing, order state machine and reconciliation against a deterministic mock broker; real orders are disabled by design.

projects.code_note: Private repository. Code walkthrough available on request.
overview: A C++20 trading research and infrastructure platform built for deterministic, low-latency processing. It ingests market data, keeps a preallocated multi-instrument market state, computes features incrementally, runs ML inference without heap allocation, and has a complete risk and order-management architecture tested against a mock broker.
Real-money order routing is deliberately not implemented.
decisions: Lock-free SPSC ring buffers and preallocated state so the hot path never blocks or allocates.
Differential oracle: the C++ port of a legacy Python strategy is checked against the original, with reference parameters pinned by SHA-256 so the comparison cannot drift.
Safety by construction: the broker boundary is an inert placeholder, and live trading cannot be armed by configuration.
Leakage-aware ML: purged walk-forward splits and explicit leakage detection before any model is trusted.
results: 214 C++ source files and 98 test files across unit, contract, failure, replay, performance and regression suites.
ASan / UBSan sanitizer builds and the full acceptance matrix certified on the reference host, with each phase documented in its own report.

projects.name: RQIE: Quant Intelligence Engine
projects.summary: Offline research engine with pre-registered experiments and a verified data store for NSE stock and option captures.
highlights: Pre-registered experiments on option-quote imbalance across 27 sessions, reporting a consistent but economically negligible effect honestly.
Gated data build with per-session verification and an independent DuckDB store audit.
Execution-economics attribution with a versioned cost model and delay stress tests; read-only by design with no broker capability.
projects.code_note: Private repository. Code walkthrough available on request.
overview: RQIE (Raj Quant Intelligence Engine) is an offline research engine for NSE stock and option data. It turns raw captures into a verified data store, runs pre-registered experiments, and reports what the data actually supports, including when the answer is that there is no edge.
It has no broker or order capability, and that is enforced by tests.

architecture.detail: Gated canonical build from raw captures with per-session verification and benchmarks.
Partitioned store checked independently with DuckDB: row counts, sizes, ordering and orphan files.
Pre-registered hypotheses with frozen specifications and a separate confirmation stage.
Execution-economics attribution with a versioned cost model and delay stress tests.
Owner decisions and approvals recorded in a research ledger.

decisions: Pre-registration: hypotheses, horizons and the smallest effect of interest are fixed before new data is examined.
The cost model never defaults brokerage; results are reported net of explicit costs and latency.
Read-only by design: it reads historical data and writes only inside its own folder.
results: Across 27 sessions, option-quote imbalance carried consistent but economically negligible information, so no executable edge was claimed.
Two quote-reversal features passed discovery but did not survive cost and delay stress; they await a frozen confirmation on new data.
